reviewScope.summary: Guild Commons presentation refinement on master 30a1749, commit 790bd2a: 42rem reading width shared with the Guild goal and member list, the existing form-details disclosure on all five Commons disclosures, an accented weekly-focus block, a visible focus ring on Commons summaries, the shared learning-group__status rule so an empty status line takes no space, and removal of empty-state lines that repeated the heading or editor. Status documentation corrected for the live S1 activation and the owner-installed S2 upgrade. Reviewed with git diff -w: no change to commands, API calls, state handling, authorization, SQL or routes; the note byline renders the same text after Prettier's rewrap.
evidence: Managed Playwright on the default build: e2e/guild-commons.spec.ts and e2e/learning-group.spec.ts, 2 passed. New assertions: Commons has the same rendered width as the member list at 1280 px (it was full panel width on master), and a keyboard-focused Commons summary has a solid outline (Chromium's default was auto). The journey's existing 320/640/1280 reflow and axe checks on the RPG Guild panel pass with the focus editor open.

One temporary capture of the same journey at 1280 and 320 px was inspected and then removed; it showed the doubled period after the focus date range, which this commit fixes. The browser run predates that one-character text fix, which no assertion depends on.

Vitest tests/features/social: 2 files, 8 tests PASS. ESLint on changed files, npm run typecheck, Prettier check, git diff --check, npm run build and npm run check:bundle (no violations or warnings; CSS gzip 20,706 B): all exit 0.
